Subtract p²; strict positivity of minima away from exact inverse-branch grid yields zero set. The transfer operator sends each full-branch union indicator to its branch-count probability, establishing all cylinder products. Exponential bound follows by optimizing two linear terms; q≥3 entropy separation from full q-shift follows. Exact rational independent checker confirmed formula and word frequencies on bounded test ranges without being used as an infinite proof.

source_inspections.title: Validity of Threshold-Crossing Analysis of Symbolic Dynamics from Chaotic Time Series

value.rationale: Arbitrary threshold crossings are a long-standing, mathematically motivated loss-of-information problem for chaotic maps. The result provides a complete degree-uniform, every-lag signed covariance classification and a non-generic rigidity theorem: a single zero covariance is equivalent to full IID binary factorization. Its q−1 distinct IID factors for every q≥3 are non-generating, showing that an apparently independent measured binary process may conceal arbitrarily high dynamical entropy log q. This answers a natural quantitative coarse-graining question rather than an isolated arbitrary numerical invariant.
